conflicts.question: Which host is the currently controlling official domain: tgprb.in or tslprb.in?
conflicts.observation: A search-index snippet attributed to tgprb.in reads 'Candidates are advised to visit only the official website: www.tslprb.in', while the recruitment PDFs enumerated above are served from tgprb.in and their own text refers to 'the TSLPRB Website (www.tgprb.in)'. Telangana's TS-to-TG renaming makes both plausible.
conflicts.why_it_matters: Every provenance record cites a URL. Citing a superseded domain would make the provenance chain unverifiable later.
conflicts.resolution_rule: Per SPEC-OFF-001 R5, do not choose silently. Resolve by loading both hosts and reading what each states about itself, then record which document or notice is controlling and on what date.

excluded_source_types.note: Coaching-site mirrors of official PDFs were visible in search results. A mirror is not the official document: it can be edited, truncated, or stale, and its bytes cannot be hashed against the publisher. Such material may later be registered as T3_EXPERT, never as T1_OFFICIAL.
